item.title: Inside Iran’s Resistance: Who Could Actually Challenge the Regime
item.description: The Iranian resistance is not a single movement. It is fragmented across Kurdish militants, diaspora monarchists, and decentralized protest networks. Understanding who these factions are and what they can actually do matters before assuming airpower can reshape Iran. #Iran #Kurds #IRGC #Geopolitics #FreeIran
